summariesJSON.title: Page 1
summariesJSON.content: The particle は, pronounced "wa," functions as the topic marker in Japanese sentences, indicating what the sentence is about. Examples include: "私は学生です。" (I am a student), "東京は大きいです。" (Tokyo is big), and "猫はかわいいです。" (Cats are cute).
